title: Розыгрыш с запиской и Максим Галкин  (The Note Prank and Maxim Galkin)

segments.t: Holding a bouquet of flowers, Max arrives at the apartment address written in the note, expecting a secret rendezvous with his older admirer. When he steps inside the open door, Kostya, Senya, and Fedya jump out snapping photos and laughing that he is just like Maxim Galkin.
Мне передали вашу записку с адресом.
Да нет, вы в самый раз.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Hello there, Maxim.' Between the point and the apartment, Max gives Kostya a quick, grounded response.
'Here I am!' Because here he is, Kostya does not bother softening the blow for Max.
'Wait, who told you my address?' Asking whether who told Kostya his address puts Kostya right on the defensive.

'What are all of you doing here?' By wondering what all of Max doing here are, Kostya presses Max for a straight answer. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.

'Someone passed me your note with the address.' With the point and secret in play, Max keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'I never passed you any note...' Around the point and secret, Kostya sets a calm, everyday tone with Max.
'The door was unlocked.' Noting that the door was unlocked keeps Max's side of the story simple and clear.
'It looks like I came at a bad time.' Even though it looks like he came at a bad time, Kostya keeps a steady face in front of Max.

'Not at all, you arrived at the perfect moment.' Over the truth and the apartment, Max answers Kostya without a second thought.

'You should really just come to the restaurant instead.' Saying that Max should really just come to the restaurant instead is how Kostya sets the tone with Max. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
'Alright then, Maxim.' Around the truth and apartment, Max sets a calm, everyday tone with Kostya.
'Maxim, man, you really are something!' Declaring that Maxim man Max really are something brings Kostya's temper right to the surface.

'You are regular Maxim Galkin.' Saying that Kostya is regular Maxim Galkin is how Max sets the tone with Kostya. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.

That wraps up this scene as dressed up with flowers, Max goes to the address from the envelope expecting his wealthy admirer, only to find Kostya, Senya, and Fedya waiting to photograph and mock him. See you next time!
